en: Ugh... I didn't think it would be\nthis cold... I can't... go on...
Eve: Rena, stay strong! Our\nparadise must be waiting for\nus just beyond this blizzard!
You're right, Eve. Just a little\nfurther... Yes, once we cross\nthat mountain, surely...

Both Ri-tan and Rena-tan are
being way too careless,
dressing like that for a snowy
mountain.

But Coro-kun said the next
supply point had natural hot
springs... I never imagined it
would be a snowy mountain like
this!

Eve: Honestly, Coro! I know
we're avoiding locals, but you
didn't have to teleport us into
the middle of nowhere like this!!
Once we reach the town, Lym\nwill make you a warm coat, so\njust bear with it until then.
I see. Lymle, you were from a\nsnowy region, just like me.

Eve, Rena, snowy countries are
wonderful. This harsh
environment nurtures a strong
heart that isn't easily shaken,
much like hers.
Exactly. "Uncle" actually says\nsomething sensible every once\nin a while.
Uncl...!?
What are you so surprised\nabout? That's what Riri-tan\nalways calls you.
Ugh... I-I see, so Relia... I-if\nthat's the case, I have no\nchoice... Argh!!
Don't worry, Captain. I was\nforged in the snowy lands; I\ncan't let this shake me... Grrr!

Huh? Come to think of it,
Lymle. Where did Cerberus go?
He was right there a moment
ago...
I sent him to scout the path to\ntown. It would be terrible if we\ngot lost in the snow.
Hmm? Speak of the devil... It\nlooks like Cerberus is back.
Wait... Is someone riding on his\nback?
He looks like a young boy...?\nDon't tell me Cerberus\nkidnapped him!?
Hmph. He wouldn't do such a\nthing.

Besides, that boy is wearing
such thin clothes in these
snowy mountains, he looks like
he's about to freeze to death!
Boy: We're heeeere! Phew,\nyou're seriously amazing!
Woof!
Who is this child?

Boy: Hehe, is this your dog?
Sorry, I borrowed him! I was
hiking down the snowy
mountain and saw a dog that
looked like fun!
Wait, you were out here in the\nsnow all by yourself? Are you\nokay?!

Boy: What do you mean,
"okay"? ...Ah! I wasn't getting
bucked off! I was riding him
perfectly, right?!
No, that's not what I meant...
Boy: More importantly, this dog!\nHe's so awesome! And the ride\nis incredible!
Boy: Wahaha, hey, stop licking\nme all of a sudden! That\ntickles!

Running around on this snow in
such thin clothes... Children in
snowy regions really are
tough...
Even in my hometown, a child\nlike this would be quite rare...
And to show no fear at all\nagainst Cerberus... his mental\nstrength is amazing.
It's rare for him to take to\nsomeone like this, too.
It certainly is strange, but...

The important thing right now
is rescuing this boy! Let's get
him to town first! He'll freeze if
he stays on this mountain!
Hey there, what's your name?
Boy: <font color=yellow>Frost</font>, why?
I'm Rena. Frost, you're going to\nfreeze if you stay out here like\nthis.
I'll be fine, I'm actually pretty\ngood with the cold.
Even so. We're heading to\ntown. Come with us.

Eh? You girls are heading to
town, but you're stuck in the
middle of these snowy
mountains?

Aha! You got lost, didn't you?
Wandering off the main road
like this is dangerous, you
know.
Huh?
Oh well, fine then. I'll guide you\nlost little sisters. Just follow\nme.
Hmm, somehow it feels like\nwe're the ones being rescued\nnow?
A-Anyway! This way we can\nbring Frost to town too, so it's\nkilling two birds with one stone!
What are you doing? That's\nwhat happens when you space\nout like that―you get lost!
Hey, wait a second! Don't just\nkeep running ahead, let's go\ntogether!

Finally, a town! A town beyond
any doubt! Now, where is that
long-awaited hot spring
steam?!

Man in Town: What's with you
lot? You thought this was a
hot spring resort? That dried
up five years ago.

Man in Town: Too bad for you.
All that's left are snow-buried
bathtubs and souvenirs nobody
wants to buy.

No way... Was Coro's info about
the hot spring town fake?
After walking through these
snowy mountains all this way...

Stay strong, Eve! It's a shame,
but at least we managed to
get Frost to the town. Let's
find Frost's family.

You're right! Once we find
Frost's family, I'll make Coro
find the best hot spring in this
star system!
But, Fu-tan. He's gone\nsomewhere, isn't he?
Huh? You're right. Where did\nyou go, Frost?!
Hm, behind that shop over\nthere! Isn't that Frost?

...Eh? Frost, what are you
trying to do?! If he keeps
pulling on that cloth under the
piled-up goods...!
The shop's things are going to\ngo kaboom!
Oh no! We have to help clean\nup!
W-Who was it?! Who did this to\nmy merchandise?!
Oops... I thought I could pull the\ncloth out like a magic trick.
You... don't tell me!
It's Frost! The snow monster,\nFrost, has appeared again!!\nEveryone, catch him this year!!
Try and catch me if you can,\nyou losers!
What do you mean? A snow\nmonster...?

Regardless, we must capture
Frost! We cannot allow him to
flee after committing such
mischief!
Hehe, I'm not so stupid that I'd\nget caught by a lost little boy\nlike you!
Alright, this shelf is all cleaned\nup!
Sorry about this, young ladies. I\nhate to have you helping me\nrearrange the merchandise...

Not at all, we should help each
other out when needed. I'm just
glad none of the items were
damaged when they fell.
Young Man: Whoa! Old man,\nwhat happened?! The shop's a\ntotal mess!

<font color=yellow>Jack</font>! It wasn't me! It was
Frost, that snow monster,
Frost! I can't believe we got hit
two years in a row...
What...? Frost...
Jack. Sorry, but could you\norganize the shelves on the\nright?
Yeah, I got it.
You mentioned "two years in a\nrow"―did something like this\nhappen last year too?

It happens every year. I reckon
every shop in this main
shopping district falls victim to
these pranks.
Oh, welcome back, Captain. It\nlooks like you couldn't catch\nthe Frost...

My apologies. We cornered it
near the entrance to town, but
a sudden blizzard blew in and
it managed to escape.
The mountains are completely\nwhite; it's too dangerous to\nchase it.

Yeah, I figured so when the
wind picked up. It's a classic
trick of that snow monster,
Frost. He can manipulate the
weather, you see.
So that sudden blizzard was\nFrost's doing, then?
What do you mean by "snow\nmonster Frost"? Who exactly is\nFrost?

For ten years, he's appeared
only in winter to play pranks. If
caught, he kicks up a blizzard
and escapes into the snowy
mountains.
See that broken fountain over\nin the park? They say Frost\nbroke that one, too.

I see. It's quite melancholy
having the fountain in the
center of town broken like
that.

I'd love to fix it, but with the
hot springs run dry, this town
lacks the funds and materials
to repair a fountain.
This is a grave situation. We\nmust catch Frost and teach\nhim a lesson immediately...!

The Captain is right. Once it
warms up, we should be able
to catch Frost even if he tries
to cause a blizzard.

I don't know why, but once the
snow melts, everyone
completely forgets what that
monster even looked like.
And I mean every single\nresident of this town, all at\nonce.
What do you mean by that?
It's probably some kind of\nsuspicious magic used by\nthose snow monsters.

As the snow melts, not just
their forms, but all memories of
those monsters vanish, just like
the snow itself.
Searching for someone we've\nnever seen in these mountains\nis certainly an impossible task.

But even though everyone
forgets, you remember being a
victim last year too, right,
Shopkeeper?
Yeah. That's because of this.
What is it, a piece of paper?\n"Snow Monster, Frost\nArrives..."?

For years, it's been leaving
traces at the shops it hits. It
left the same kind of paper
last year, too.
Leaving something like this on\npurpose... it's almost as if it\nwants to be caught.
But Frost just runs off into the\nsnow so it won't get caught.
And that's why we've been\nsuffering from its pranks year\nafter year.
Pops, I'm done cleaning up over\nhere.

Oh, I'm finished on this end too.
You all really helped me out
with the cleanup. Looks like I
can reopen the shop now!
Ah, Captain! Sorry, I spaced\nout during the resupply\nmission.
Yeah, I was thinking about\nFrost...

When we met in the snowy
mountains, you didn't seem like
the type to keep playing
pranks and causing trouble for
everyone.
I was just wondering why Frost\nis doing such things...

You want to find Frost,
Captain?! In this snow!? The
blizzard has died down, but we
have no idea where they could
be...
It'll be easy if we have a good\nnose like Wan-wan!
Woof!

I believe that those who
commit misdeeds must be
judged. They cannot be allowed
to keep running.
In that case, there is only one\ncourse of action. Let's go find\nFrost!
Um, are you going to look for\nFrost? If you don't mind, I'd like\nto come too...
Hmm? Oh, were you Jack, the\nshopkeeper's son?

I understand your anger over
the shop being vandalized, but
the snowy mountains are
dangerous. Please wait here.
Leave it to us!
Found you, Frost!
What!? Why are you guys\nhere!? I thought I lost you in\nthe blizzard!
It was the Doggie Bite! Hehe!
...So you tracked my scent.\nTsk, I should've made the snow\neven heavier.
Regardless, this is quite the\ncavern. Judging by the\nstructure, is it man-made?

It's a cave where townspeople
are digging to revive the
dried-up hot spring. Not that
anyone visits here this time of
year, though.
I haven't reached the spring,\nbut listening to the earth, I can\nfeel a water vein nearby.

I hate seeing everyone so
gloomy since the hot spring
dried up, so I'll finish the
digging for them!
Digging? How are you\nsupposed to do that all by\nyourself without any tools?
Heh! Around here, it's a known\nfact that snow monsters are\nincredibly strong!

Hey, Frost. Don't you want to
be friends with everyone?
You're even digging a hot
spring to help the town
recover...

If you want to be friends, don't
play pranks! Let's go back,
apologize, and help fix what
you broke...
...That won't work. If I do that,\nno one will ever remember me.
Huh? What do you mean?

When the snow melts, not just
the monster, but all memories
of it vanish too. Just like the
snow itself melting away.
...Exactly. When the snow melts,\neveryone in town completely\nforgets all about me.

Snow monsters fall into a deep
sleep once the snowy season
ends, until the next one
arrives.

It's a shock, I'll tell you. I wake
up from my slumber, head to
town, and find that nobody
remembers me...
So, the reason people can't\nremember Frost isn't because\nof a spell he used to escape.
Why would I ever use a spell to\nmake everyone forget me?\n...This is more like a curse.

But since I'm a snow monster
and the snow itself, I'll just
melt away from everyone's
hearts along with the snow...

Even if they forget, you can
just introduce yourself all over
again! Then you can become
friends again...

I've already tried that!! Over
and over, and over again...!!
...But everyone still forgets. Not
a single person remembers...
Frost...
But a few years ago, something\nincredible happened.

Back then, I was playing tag in
the park with a new friend. I
got a bit carried away chasing
them and ended up breaking
the fountain.

To break a stone fountain like
that... your physical strength is
quite considerable, just as you
mentioned earlier.

I am a monster, after all! The
loud noise from the destruction
caused a commotion, so I ran
away as fast as I could.

I figured that once the snowy
season ended, everyone would
forget who did it, just like the
snow melts away.

But I was wrong. They didn't
remember my face, but they
were gossiping about some
brat breaking the fountain last
winter!

Evil deeds travel a thousand
miles, as they say. It is true
that misdeeds often spread
more easily than good deeds.

No matter how close I get,
people always forget me―but
the townspeople actually
remembered what I did!

So, are you saying you've been
going around playing pranks in
conspicuous places on
purpose?

Exactly! That shopkeeper
remembered someone knocking
over their goods the same way
last year, right? They hadn't
forgotten me!
You can't do this! If you keep\nthis up, everyone is going to\nend up hating you, Frost!
...So what if they do? What's\nwrong with being hated?
What? But... if people hate you,\nit'll hurt, won't it?
Being forgotten hurts way\nmore than being hated.

Do you sisters understand? A
friend I made... they woke up
from a nap and looked at me
like I was a complete stranger.

Even so, I kept trying to be
friends, calling out every year...
but they just kept growing up,
and eventually, they stopped
playing with me.
And then, they'll forget all\nabout me... forever.
Frost...

Anyway, weren't you sisters
here to catch me? I don't mind,
but watch out for the blizzard
until we reach the city.
Look, I can hear the wind\nhowling right...
What is it?
There's a beast's cry mixed in\nwith the wind...! And wait, that's\na human voice!!

A human voice...? Someone
might be under attack by a
beast on the path! We must
pursue Frost as well!
Oh no! A beast is attacking\nsomeone in town! Wait... that's\nJack, the shopkeeper's son!
Get to a safe place and stay\nhidden!
Ugh... sorry... You be careful\ntoo... Frost...!
Wait... did he just... say my\nname...?
Don't lose focus with the\nenemy right in front of us,\nFrost! Here they come!!
Phew, I think we managed to\ndrive the beasts away.

Hmm, these beasts are
different from the usual packs.
They seem driven from their
habitat and turned aggressive...
the town might be in danger.
I need to find a way to alert\nthe town guard before the\npack returns...
Frost... I really think playing\npranks is a bad idea.
That again? I already told you.\nIf you want to catch me, go\nahead.

That's not it! I think it's wrong
for Frost, who cares so much
about this town, to be
misunderstood like this.
Then what do you want me to\ndo?! If there were any other\nway, I wouldn't be doing this!
...I'd much rather be hated and\nremembered than be forgotten\nforever...!
I remember, Frost!!

Twelve years ago, we secretly
graffitied the shop pillar so our
old man wouldn't find out. That
graffiti still hasn't been
discovered.

What, Jack...? How do you
remember that? I mean, the
snow has melted so many
times since then...
No matter how forgetful I am,\nI'll never forget an important\nfriend. Frost.

I was trying to act cool, but
sorry. I'd forgotten everything
for 12 years... until I saw that
graffiti on the pillar.

You remembered just from the
graffiti? No one else ever
remembered me, even when I
showed them things from our
past!

Yeah, the graffiti alone didn't
bring it back, and it left me
feeling restless. So I went
looking for something that
might trigger my memory.
And then I found this.
This is... um, what? It looks like\na swarm of earthworms\ncrawling around...
This is my picture diary from\nmy winter break homework!
Such messy handwriting and\nterrible drawings...

You're as foul-mouthed as
ever. But you know, looking at
this helped me remember your
face, too.
No, honestly, being reminded of\nthings through these drawings\nactually hurts my feelings.
Haha, true. But I don't know\nwhy, it all came back to me so\nvividly.
I see, so this is it! Frost's\npower isn't erasing the\nmemories of him!

They've just been buried deep
within their memories, and as
long as there's a trigger,
everyone can remember Frost!
That's why you were able to\nremember Fu-tan through that\nweird drawing, right?
Exactly. Snow melts and turns\ninto water or water vapor, but\nit never truly disappears.

Frost's memories are the same.
They won't just vanish. They've
been inside Jack's heart all
along.

So it's the same for the
townspeople. That broken
fountain is helping bring back
memories of Frost, even if only
a little.

Precisely! If we give the
townspeople a way to
remember Frost, he won't need
to play pranks just to be
noticed!

Hmm. Once we know the
method, the rest is simple. He
must apologize to the town,
atone for his sins, and become
friends with everyone once
more.
We should start with that\nfountain...
I came all this way because I\njust had to apologize to you\nabout that fountain!
About the fountain?
Y-You! That's...!

To tell you the truth, I was the
one who first broke the park
fountain. I snapped the nozzle,
and water started spraying
everywhere...

Frost tried to take the blame
by breaking it even more
spectacularly just to protect
me.
Back then, I thought everyone\nwould forget once the snowy\nseason was over.

While worrying about when to
tell the townspeople the truth, I
forgot what I did along with the
snowmelt...
I'm the worst. To pin all the\nblame on a friend and then just\nforget about it.
No, that's just the power of my\nsnow monster. You didn't do\nanything, Jack...!

I'll tell everyone in town for real
this time. I'm 18 now. Even if I
have to pay for repairs, I'll find
a way to make some money...
Hm? What was that tremor?!

!! That beast's cry is mixing
into the wind!! There are more
than twice as many beasts as
before!!
Over there! I saw them! There's\na huge one too!!
What the―?! I've never seen a\nbeast like that around here!!
Jack!! Get back to town and\nwarn the guards! I'll handle\nthings here!!
...Agh, alright! Don't do anything\nreckless, Frost!!
Everyone, let's protect the\ntown that Frost loves so much!!
I won't let you destroy this\ntown!! Raaaaaaaah!!
Such strength... I shouldn't\nhave underestimated those\nsnow monsters.
There, that should do it!
We've driven off quite a few\nbeasts, so the town should be\nsafe now.
Hmph, but the ground is still all\nwobbly and shaky under my\nfeet.

What is this shaking!? It
doesn't feel like enemies
approaching, but like something
is trembling deep beneath the
earth...

Town Elder: Thank you so
much. Not only did you protect
our town, but you even found a
hot spring vein...

Town Elder: With this, we can
restore this desolate town into
a hot spring resort! I cannot
thank you enough...

We weren't the ones who found
the vein, it was Frost. Frost
was also a hero in the battle to
protect the town.
Townspeople: Huh, Frost...?\nYou don't mean... the snow\nmonster, Frost!?

Townspeople: That prankster
Frost found a hot spring!? I
hope this doesn't turn into
something strange...
Everyone! If you want to thank\nus for what we've done, please\ngive Frost a chance to speak!
Village Elder: Hmm!? This brat\nis that Frost!?
Townspeople: That little brat!\nHe trashed my shop too! I'm\ngonna catch him!!
Everyone, please! Just listen to\nhim...!
Don't worry about it, sis. I know\nI've gotta take responsibility\nfor what I've done.

Everyone in town, I'm sorry for
all the trouble I've caused you
over the years. I apologize for
everything.
You're right, that was\nwonderful! Everyone is finally\naccepting Frost...

It's because Frost remembered
every single person he played
pranks on and gave a sincere
apology.
And his secret efforts to\nprotect the town from beasts\nfor all these years...

...as well as his search for a
new water vein since the hot
springs dried up five years ago,
must have been highly valued.
It's because everyone could\nfeel how much Fu-tan loves\nthis town!
However, that does not mean\nyou are off the hook. You\nunderstand that, Frost?
You don't have to keep\nreminding me, "old man."
Frost... even you...

Helping the shops I pranked
during the snowy season,
guarding the outskirts, and
searching for water veins... My
head is spinning.

And don't forget about
repairing the fountain, too! I'll
help you out, so let's give it our
all!
That too, huh... Jeez, I really\ndon't know where to start\nanymore.

Then, why don't you make a
chore schedule? If you hand it
out to the townspeople, no one
will forget about you, Frost.
Though, it'll mean you won't be\nallowed to slack off anymore,\neither~.
If you want, I could make one\nwith caricatures on it?
Jack's caricatures don't look\nlike the person at all. Lymle is\nthe one in charge of drawing!
Man: Hey! Jack! Should I just\nleave this sign here?
Yeah, that's fine. Thanks!
Hmm? What sign? Let's see...\n"Frost Spring"?

I've never heard of a snow
monster finding a hot spring.
We'll use that as a
catchphrase to attract
tourists.
Hey, don't just go using my\nname without my permission!\nI'm gonna charge you a fee!
Well, that fee will go straight\ntoward the funds for repairing\nthe fountain.
Gah...!
Isn't that a wonderful idea? It\nwould bring life back to this\ntown,

and more than anything, it
would leave reminders of Frost
all over the place for everyone
to remember him.

Frost is just like snow. Even
when it melts into vapor, it
continues to play an active role
all throughout this town.

This story has ended. We plan
to release various other stories
in the future. Please look
forward to them.
Alright, this time for sure...
Claude, no!! You can't just draw\nyour weapon in a place like\nthis!!
Waaaaah!! Rena! You scared\nme...
You're the one who scared me!\nThat was dangerous! Put your\nweapon away, quickly!
Stall Owner: Hahaha, miss, is\nthis your first time playing\nshooting gallery?
Eh? Shooting gallery?

It's a game. You load cork
bullets into this gun and try to
knock the targets off the
boxes on that shelf over there.

Oh, I didn't know that was a
game. But Claude, you train
with guns as a soldier all the
time, right? Isn't this easy for
you?

Stall Owner: "Easy," she says.
Why don't you give it a try
yourself, miss? I'll give you one
shot for free!
Really? Thank you very much.
So I aim for those boxes from\nhere. Alright, taking aim...
I did it! A direct hit, right in the\ncenter!
...Huh? Wait, I hit it, but it won't\nfall...

Stall Owner: Tough luck, kid!
You've got talent just hitting
that box on your first shot.
Want to go another round?
It's frustrating if it doesn't fall.\nI'll try again!
Alright, I'm not giving up yet!\nHey mister, one more round!
Stall Owner: Heh heh, you got\nit!
Ugh, to think we both lost so\nbadly...
Dammit... I'm hitting it, too. I'm\nall out of coins. Is this my last\nshot...?
Claude. Would you care to\nwager that final shot on me?
Henri! When did you get here?!
My apologies, you were so\nabsorbed that I missed my\ntiming to speak to you.
So, what will you do with that\nlast shot?
Amazing! The box actually fell!

I only did exactly what you
said, Henri... I never imagined I
could drop the box in a single
shot.
Henri! How can I learn to drop\nthe boxes like that?

It is not difficult. You simply
need to follow the laws of
physics and derive the optimal
solution.
The laws of physics?

Yes. First, the gun. The
cork-ejecting springs vary in
strength, so choose the
newest gun possible.

Next, pack the cork with the
pointed end facing the target.
A smaller surface area upon
impact will increase the force.
I see, I see.
And finally, do not aim for the\ncenter of the target; aim for\nthe upper right corner.
Eh? Why is that? You have to\naim for the center!

We aren't fighting an enemy,
just toppling a stationary box.
If we aim as far from its center
of gravity as possible...

Ah, that would throw off the
balance and make it spin
around! If that's the case, it
should fall over easily!
Stall Owner: Wh-what?!
Oh, I see! His explanation is so\nlogical and easy to understand!
Yay! I did exactly what that\nguy said and I got it!
I'm going again! I'm definitely\ngonna knock it down this time!
Alright, it's time for my\nrevenge!

Shopkeeper: N-No way!! You're
ruining my business talking like
that! The three of you are
banned! Get lost!
Waaaaah!!
Too bad, we can't go near the\nshooting gallery anymore.
I-I'm sorry. This is all my fault...
No, I still got my last prize, and\nthank you for the advice.

I'm relieved to hear that. I'd
rather not be glared at by the
shopkeeper any longer, so I
shall return to the ship for
now.
Farewell, Claude. I wish you the\nbest of luck.
Wait, hold on, Henri!!
...Does Henri-san really see\nthrough everything...?
...? What do you mean, "see\nthrough everything"?
Uh... Rena, this is... for you. Will\nyou take it?
Open it.

Ah, but maybe shooting gallery
prizes aren't your style? There
was a jewelry shop over there,
so I should've gone to a proper
store...!

No! I love this! The design is so
delicate and beautiful! You
really have a great sense for
choosing accessories, Claude!
How... does it look? Does it suit\nme?
Yeah, it looks amazing on you.
Thank you so much, Claude. I'll\ntreasure it.

I only applied because it
sounded interesting, but there
are many participants. "Hot
Spring Table Tennis
Tournament"...

Yeah, if the Captain and I team
up for doubles, I don't feel like
we can lose to anyone. Alright,
let's aim for the championship!

Tournament Organizer: Excuse
me, you can't use that racket!
Please make sure to read the
tournament guidelines properly.
Eh, it's not a regular table\ntennis tournament?

Let's see, according to the
guidelines, "The racket to be
used will be determined by a
lottery on the day!"...

Don't tell me we're using those
washbasins or coffee milk
bottles as rackets? That's way
too difficult!

Tournament Organizer: No, no,
everyone is doing their best
and getting creative. Now,
please draw your lot!
W-well, if those are the rules, I\nguess it can't be helped.\n...Alright, here goes!!

Tournament Organizer: Oh,
here is the item from your lot.
Good luck in the tournament
using this as your racket!
